description.name: Triple Sphere Mode (Ice, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lulu
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Ultima Fury (0~2), removed after using Ultima Fury two times

description.name: Ultima Fury Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Ultima Fury level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lulu]

description.name: Ultima Fury Level
description.text: Keeps track of Ultima Fury level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lulu]
